subject: Arcana Labs partner onramp — technical checkpoints and runbook
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@arcanalabs.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: integration@arcanalabs.com
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Arcana — Redwood onramp: reference design and initial test plan

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the intro call this morning. As discussed, attached is a short reference design for the initial onramp plus a draft interoperability test matrix. Our goal is to qualify a minimal reference flow (auth -> inference -> telemetry) in your private deployment within two sprints.

Key asks from us today:
- Confirm network egress expectations and any required IP allowlists for private deployment.
- Share a preferred test window for a brief connectivity smoke test next week.
- Identify one engineer from Redwood to pair on the initial KV/cache behavior validation.

Attachments: arcana-reference-design.md (Markdown), interop-test-matrix.csv (CSV)

Elena Morales
Head of Integrations, Arcana Labs
elena@arcanalabs.com
[Attachment: arcana-reference-design.md (text/markdown)]
[Attachment: interop-test-matrix.csv (text/csv)]

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@arcanalabs.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Arcana — Redwood onramp: reference design and initial test plan

Elena — thanks for sending this over and for the clear plan. Looping in Karthik (runtime/serving) and Sergio (partners/ops) to coordinate the validation steps.

Quick answers and next steps:
- Network: For private we require a shortlist of outbound IPs for the test agents; we can provide a CIDR block and a short-lived certificate if you prefer mTLS. I attached our standard network diagram for private onramps — please review the egress entries under "Partner Agents".
- Test window: Karthik and I are available for a connectivity smoke on Thursday Aug 6 from 9:00–11:00 PT. If that works for your team we'll schedule a 30-min pairing session.
- KV/cache pairing: Karthik will be the primary contact for KV cache behavior checks. He'll want to validate prefix caching and warmup behavior against a 128-token median sequence.

I've created a shared Drive folder and a Jira ticket to track the runbook and test outcomes: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ArcanaOnrampPlaybook and ENG-4821.

Attachments: network-diagram.png (PNG)

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Partner Alliances, Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com
[Attachment: network-diagram.png (image/png)]

From: Elena Morales <elena@arcanalabs.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 08:09:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Arcana — Redwood onramp: reference design and initial test plan

On Tue, Aug 4, 2026 at 11:03 Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com> wrote:
> Elena — thanks for sending this over and for the clear plan. Looping in Karthik (runtime/serving) and Sergio (partners/ops) to coordinate the validation steps.

Thanks Naomi — that window works. We'll plan to run the following during the 30-min pairing:
- Connectivity: confirm TLS handshake and allowed CIDR.
- Authentication: validate token exchange (Arcana service principal -> Redwood API).
- Basic inference smoke: run 10 short queries to validate latency and KV warm hits.
- Telemetry: ensure span & token-level logging flows to our observability pipeline for the sample traces.

I'll bring our lead engineer, Marco Ruiz (marco@arcanalabs.com), to the call. He'll have the interop test runner ready and the CSV contains the initial scenarios.

Also: attached a brief note on our expectation for max-concurrent requests per agent during the pilot (small footprint). Please flag any constraints on your side.

Thanks — looking forward to Thursday.

Elena
[Attachment: arcana-pilot-load-profile.md (text/markdown)]

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@arcanalabs.com>, Marco Ruiz <marco@arcanalabs.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 16:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Arcana — Redwood onramp: reference design and initial test plan

Elena / Marco — great, confirmed for today at 9:00 PT. Calendar invite sent (30 min).

Pre-call checklist (for visibility):
- Arcana: interop-test-matrix.csv + pilot load profile (please make sure the runner can toggle sequence lengths between 32/128/512).
- Redwood: Karthik will instrument a short KV trace capture and Sergio will validate telemetry ingestion mapping.
- Network: Naomi will provision the test CIDR and temporary mTLS cert; security will revoke after the smoke.

Post-call deliverables (expected):
1) Updated runbook with observed latency ranges and any kernel/quantization adjustments.
2) Pass/fail rows in interop-test-matrix.csv and attachments uploaded to the shared drive.
3) Jira ENG-4821 updated with acceptance criteria and next steps for a 2-sprint pilot.

If anything changes ping me in #partners or reply-all. See you at 9:00 PT.

— Naomi
Partner Alliances, Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com
[Calendar invite: Arcana — Redwood onramp smoke (Aug 6, 09:00–09:30 PT)]
